blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — House of Representatives Majority Leader Ferdinand Alexander “Sandro” Marcos’ decision to join Lakas-CMD was meant to fill up the leadership void following his uncle’s arrest, Batangas Rep. Gerville Luistro said on Thursday. Luistro, a member of Lakas-CMD, confirmed in an online interview that Marcos indeed joined the party, with the purpose being to oversee the party’s operations — a role that belonged to his uncle, former House Speaker Ferdinand Martin Romualdez, who had been detained since early September due to plunder raps.
